i truly wanted to like this movie for its story elements because i loved the costumes, camera work (especially the use of the fisheye lens), art design, makeup, set design, and most importantly, bella. but i found myself so repulsed and deeply disappointed by the turn her character makes in the paris act, as it turns her into a sex worker and is only valuable through the eyes of men, or throughout the whole film, seen plainly as a pet to them until the very end. the disapproval she meets often in others for having questions about her circumstances permits the ones around her to have mental illness be the label they choose to give her for her way of self-expression, which really got under my skin. before the paris act, I saw a lot of myself in her, in bella's curiosity and pursuit of enlightenment and discovery with everything around her. it felt so familiar to me in the ways i’ve had to constantly reprocess, rephrase and suppress my own ideas of love, movement, gender, intimacy, shame, responsibility, friendship, work, privacy, interests, and pleasure as things to keep to oneself as it is "too much" or " too rude" to openly discuss in society, as well as the very fear of being perceived or being openly blunt in social acts, as it's just de-masking and true honesty in the way of an autistic person, but rather received as cruelty, anger or apathy by others if our faces or tonality don't fit the norm. the way she communicates throughout the film is so refreshing. she comes to find her own power in her decisions and to disregard norms entirely, and refuses to comfort anyone who finds that offensive, but during the whole paris act she lost me almost instantly, and then finally getting back to london in the final, it was extremely difficult for me to reconnect and reground her as a character to the point where i had no response to the ending. it was such a letdown and puzzling film.

This is not sexual liberation(more like csa). This is a man incapable to view women as more than desirable, sexual objects. Thus, the protagonist(still a child btw.), explores herself mainly through sex with men and in relation to the men in her life. I am not going to applaud such lazy "feminism", made by a man, which as the movie unravels, reveals itself as a fetishy fantasy. If you want movies dealing with feminist topics(even made by a man!) Watch "perfect blue", or others..

The art department absolutely ATE. Costumes, set design, make-up & sfx artists, visual direction…10/10 across the board, pure craftsmanship. As for the concept & screenplay? 2/10 A completely wasted opportunity. People keep calling this "subversive feminism," but the film’s actual structure tells a very different story. For over 80% of the runtime, we are forced to watch the voyeuristic objectification of a woman with the cognitive capacity of a child, left at the mercy of repulsive, predatory men. Calling this a 'journey toward sexual freedom' feels completely disingenuous when most of the movie is just a front-row seat to predatory men manipulating and mocking a woman's lack of boundaries. The supposed "subversion" is barely given any room to breathe. Bella’s actual intellectual, philosophical, and political awakening is crammed into the final act, acting as a thin, theoretical excuse to justify two hours of hyper-sexualization. There is a fine line between satirizing misogynistic reality and merely staging it for stylized entertainment, and the film crosses it completely. Stripped to its core, the movie spends nearly its entire duration packaging a deeply disturbing ethical conflict into a glossy visual spectacle. Wrapping predatory dynamic  in stunning aesthetics and calling it "liberation and empowerment " isn't subversive—it’s just intellectual laziness.

Feminism written through the highly sexualised visual perspective of men. A woman is so often associated with the consumption of her body whenever a film tries to portray female liberation, as if a woman’s freedom can only be expressed through her body. Bella was able to free herself from society’s expectations, yet the film framed that freedom through the very thing she should be liberated from.

The born sexy yesterday trope is not feminist. These writers asked themselves: What would happen if a woman set herself to become independent, curious and educated, if she decided to see the world for herself and find her true self and vocation in life? And their answer was: She would become a prostitute of course.

I will say, though, the cinematography, set design, colors, and outfits were spectacular, but that’s really it. Final rating: 4/10

Me vi esta película para un ensayo, la vi a las 10 de la noche. Imagínense mi cara dormida tratando de no dormirme y dejar el teléfono expuesto para que justo salga una escena de esta tipa cabalgando polla por sexta vez en la película y que mi santa abuela pensase que estaba toqueteándome. Los escenarios eran un porro del tamaño de mi brazo, es ilegal seguir con coherencia en ciertas ocasiones. Pero se entiende el punto principal, claro que ahora mismo no recuerdo tanto porque estaba tratando de no dormitar y que no me diese un aneurisma por el hecho de solo prestar atención y que la escena fuera de lo más sureal. Buenos actores igual porque de verdad es otro nivel tener esos comportamientos tan aberrantes. Jamás la volvería a ver, pero ok, ha de haber gente que le haya parecido una obra maestra, pero para un ensayo de una materia insoportable pues un poco exagerada la elección. Es solo mi humilde experiencia y pues bien por aquellos que dieron sus neuronas para dar más allá que sus explicaciones sobre ensayos piteros. Un beso.

I really don’t know how to feel about this. The aesthetics are amazing and the idea is interesting, but there are things I just can’t ignore that make my experience watching this not as great as I would like. I can’t accept or pretend it’s normal for a grown man in his 30s to be lusting after and romantically captivated by a child in a woman’s body. To me, in all the sexual scenes, I couldn’t see anything more than men having sex with a child who doesn’t even understand what she’s doing and calls it “furious jumping.” She doesn’t have any actual idea about what’s happening and is driven by curiosity and the desire to satisfy the sexual urges that come with the body she’s now in. But that, to me, is still nothing more than a curious child trying to obtain “happiness,” as she calls it, through physical pleasure that she would otherwise have no understanding of if she hadn’t been placed in that woman’s adult body. Let’s not pretend that putting a feminist, female liberation framing around it makes something deeply disturbing any less disturbing than what it is: the sexualization of a character who is mentally a child, regardless of the fact that her body is that of an adult. All the amazing aesthetics and other praiseworthy visual aspects aside, this just ends up feeling like a poor representation of feminism through the eyes of a man. To me, if this was an attempt to make a statement and address the sexualization of children in today’s day and age, it failed miserably, because it ends up feeling more like a fantasy that normalizes the very things it tries to address.

Disappointing as it had a lot of potential and i loved the visual but if you match the body to the age of the brain you see how disturbed this movie is. Only reason its getting two stars is the performance and the visuals, plot wise its grotesque.

مراجعة بكل شفافية، لانثيموس من اذكى المخرجين في طريقة طرح القصة كأساس، ولكن لا يمكنك ان تثق فيه في السرد "عالأقل في هذا الفيلم" لأن لي تجارب عظيمة مع لانثيموس انا على معرفة أن يوجد مخرجين لديهم تقديس للجنس ولكن انا لست مجبر أن اتقبّل هذا او اتفهّم المخرج، العمل يحمل رسايل ثقيلة مابين الآثار الأخلاقية والغير اخلاقية وأكثر.. كان بإمكانه استغلالها بشكل أجمل بكثير مما عُرِض، لطالما نعترض على اتفه المبالغات في الأعمال في اي شيء يبالغ في عرضه صانع العمل ليس فقط الجنس، حتى في الصفات النبيلة مثالاً لو أردت ان تعرض شخصية تتمتّع بأخلاقيات جميلة لا تبالغ وتعرضها وكأنها شخصية مثالية مملة، وهكذا، فـ أتحدّث على جميع المبالغات فما الذي سيجعلني أستثني لانثيموس من هذه القاعدة؟ تسليم عقولنا بهذا الشكل للمخرجين سيجعلنا في موقف اننا ليس لنا حق النقد بالأخص في فيلم مكانه ليس السينما وأعذروني في ما أرمي إليه، وأنا لا أُبالغ ولكن هذا ما قُدِّم لي اخيراً تمثيل رائع والإخراج كعادة لانثيموس بديع بديع بديع جداً، إيطارات خلّابة.

O filme como um todo é incrível, toda a sua composição e a maneira como é feito demonstram o quanto cuidado foi posto no filme. Porem esse não é um filme pra todos, ele passa uma sensação muito íntima, parece q vc tá olhando sem ser convidado uma pessoa descobrir como viver. E por isso acho q esse não é um filme pra mim, o desconforto q eu passei nesse filme foi imenso, me dava vontade de desligar a tv a todo momento, o filme quer te chocar e ele consegue. Eu fiquei extremamente incomodado com o fato de q o filme durante o filme as pessoas se aproveitam da Bella, ela é uma criança no corpo de um adulto, de maneira literal, e esse desconforto não saiu de mim durante o filme todo. Mas consigo ver o pq do filme ser tão aclamado.
